title: The Stool Already by the Sink
youtube_title: The Stool Already by the Sink | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A thank-you that takes effort feels true.
summary: At a library corner with a paper ribbon in a book, Kito notices that Mr. Ade has already taken care of a stool already pulled to the sink. A quick thank-you feels too thin, so Kito does one useful thing Mr. Ade did not ask for and then says, plainly, that they noticed.
